config.source: On-device benchmark run by the app team (Google Antigravity agent in Android Studio) on the owner's phone; summary values read from the device screen and pasted by the owner on 2026-10-19. No raw per-run timing log was provided; values are NOT independently verified by this repo.
config.app_build: com.cyvach.research (isolated research build of SMSReaderApp), model asset renamed cyvach_v8.onnx (Option B)
config.protocol: 50 warm-up + 200 timed runs, one English SMS, ML Kit language detection bypassed during timing; full path = tokenizer + session.run + rule layer; model only = session.run

device.soc: MediaTek Dimensity 8020 (4x Cortex-A78 2.6 GHz + 4x Cortex-A55 2.0 GHz)
device.onnxruntime: onnxruntime-react-native 1.23.0, onnxruntime-android:latest.integration (resolved AAR version not reported)

latency_ms_clean_run.cold_start_definition: app start to first answer: read 67.3 MB model from flash, create ONNX session, first un-warmed inference

latency_ms_first_run_superseded.note: ran after ~1,500 background inbox SMS imports (per app team); its 'cold start 68 ms' was not a true cold start. Superseded by the clean run.

memory_mb_first_run.note: dumpsys meminfo, measured during the first (background-loaded) run; not re-measured in the clean run

spot_check.note: labels identical to the PC reference; confidences differ by up to 6 points (S13: 70.5 device vs 76.7 PC), consistent with ARM vs x86 INT8 kernel differences
